Timothée Chalamet is under fire for calling Helen Keller “not real”

“There’s zero chance she existed. You expect me to believe that girl managed to fly an airplane?” https://t.co/T38d0zv0hq
post.author_description: PARODY Hip-Hop News | Follow For Viral Content | These are fake stories | Not impersonating and not affiliated with @DailyLoud

description.description: A medium shot of actor Timothée Chalamet during a talk show appearance. He has dark wavy hair, a thin mustache, and a soul patch. He is wearing a light orange button-down shirt over a white undershirt and a thin gold chain necklace. He is looking slightly to his left while speaking. The background consists of a blurred studio audience.

A black and white profile portrait of Helen Keller as a young woman. She is shown from the chest up, facing right with her eyes closed or looking slightly downward. She has her hair pulled back into a bun and is wearing a high-collared white lace dress with concentric patterns. The background is a plain, solid light color.
